name: no-targets
description: The export filter matches nothing scannable -- here one hostname-only asset whose `address` column is empty, which is what an asset discovered by a custom integration rather than a network observation looks like in this CSV. The behaviour under test is the early return: with zero addresses the script must stop BEFORE connecting to Greenbone and say which filter came up empty, because creating a Greenbone target with no hosts and then starting a task against it produces a scan that runs and finds nothing, and an operator reading the Greenbone side cannot tell that apart from a scan that legitimately found nothing. request_count==1 is the assertion that the GMP leg was never reached -- and it is also why this scenario needs no transport parameters at all, unlike its sibling.
